capabilities: audit the currently open note for SEO issues
scan all notes in configured vault directories
score notes with weighted checks for links, headings, keywords, and alt text
detect broken internal links, broken embeds, and optionally unreachable external links
jump directly to files with issues from the audit panel
extras: The external link check needs an internet connection, is disabled by default, and all other checks run offline. The README promotes Zeku, a paid sibling app from the same developer.
motivation: The README says it was made for the Vault CMS project, for authors publishing notes to websites.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to check notes for search-engine problems like duplicate titles, missing alt text, or broken links before publishing them.

relations.evidence: Part of the Vault CMS project.

summary: SEO analysis plugin that audits current or vault-wide notes for content, technical, and link issues and assigns an SEO score.
